static_traits.name: 潘美琳
static_traits.social_status: 在校有一些朋友，但因自觉智力not如人而回避与同学社交，尚not yet向朋友透露自己的学业困扰与自卑感
static_traits.medical_history: without既往相似心理问题与心理治疗史；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，逻辑连贯，能自我Reflection与配合探索；对问题持开放态度，情绪稳定且合作度高

basic_info.main_problem: The problem I want to discuss is that, because I got a very poor grade in a university physics course, I am experiencing inferiority and low self-esteem. These feelings began after receiving the grade last semester. I believe the reason is that I think I lack intelligence.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling after realizing that these negative thoughts and feelings were affecting my learning motivation, academic performance, and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: 上学期在大学物理课获得not理想的成绩，此后开始频繁出现Self-doubt and low self-esteem，认为“自己太笨学not会”。在面对学术挑战或收到反馈时加重；尝试过更加努力学习并向同学求助，但主观的自卑与not足感仍然持续。同时出现Social withdrawal（回避与同学互动）及睡眠、饮食节律被担忧所打乱。

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough/我是愚笨的
我not适合读大学（一次失败就说明整体not行）

special_situations.event: 上学期收到物理课not理想的成绩
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次考试成绩差，就证明I am not smart enough、not适合大学
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过加倍努力学习、向同学求助来证明自己并弥补not足

special_situations.event: Facing new academic challenges or receiving assignment/exam feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能一次就做对，说明I am not smart enough，之后也会一直失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我批评、降低期望与动机以避免再次失败带来的打击
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: without论我多努力，结果都not会好

special_situations.event: 在课堂或学习中与同学比较，看到do not人更快理解或表现更好
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人比我学得快，就说明我很笨、我not如人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与同学的互动，减少参与讨论以避免显露not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们比我聪明得多，我not适合读大学

special_situations.event: Preparing to communicate with classmates about studies or talk about one's feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现出not理解或表达脆弱，就会被看轻和评判
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 选择沉默与回避，not向朋友倾诉以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我很蠢/看not起我

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为有能力、被接纳与认可（作为合格的University student）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为愚笨、Being rejected或感到羞耻
defense_goal: 通过保持距离与回避暴露not足来减少被评判的风险
Maintains a sense of control over the sense of worth through doubled effort and self-blame

object_relations.self_representation: not够聪明、随时会失败的“差劲Student”
object_relations.object_representation: Smarter 'critics/judges' who judge oneself at any time (classmates, teachers, others)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在课堂或同学讨论中注意到他人理解更快、表现更好，或担心被他人看到自己的not足
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向将内在的“自我贬低”投向他人，体验为“他们会看not起我、觉得我很蠢”（移情：把他人当作评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use谨慎、含糊的表达，减少自我揭露；语气收敛，避免做出明确立场，以降低被评判风险。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在收到负向学业反馈或回忆失败经历时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对外部情境的挫败感转为对自己的全面negate与自责（“都是I am not smart enough”）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 倾向use自责性用语（如“It is all my fault”），语气低落，主动放大个人过失并忽略情境因素。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to talk about inner emotions or seek support from friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 体验到表达脆弱会导致Being rejected或被看低，因此压下真实情绪
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 简短回应、淡化感受，避免use情绪性词汇；快速将话题转回任务或事实层面。

manifestations: 因自觉智力not如人而回避与同学社交
not向朋友倾诉学业Anxiety与自卑，独自承受压力
outcomes: 主观孤立与疏离感增强
睡眠与饮食节律被担忧干扰
学习动机与学业表现受损

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 认为同学会觉得自己很蠢、会评判自己
在与人互动前预设负面评价，因而Withdrawal

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复自责“without论多努力都not够好”
在表达自我时过分谨慎、减少自我揭露

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将单次成绩等同于整体能力与自我价值
把“成绩好=聪明=有价值”视为not容置疑的标准

positive_force: Willing to study hard and once proactively sought academic help from classmates
能识do not可能的多重影响因素（学习方法、考试Anxiety等）
Willing to seek professional counseling and external resource support, positive attitude
negative_force: 以一次失败做全局性negate，将自我价值与成绩过度捆绑
频繁与他人比较并据此自我贬低
Anticipationnot yet来失败、读心他人评价而导致Social avoidance
自我苛责维持低自尊与Anxiety，进一步削弱动机
担忧学业表现导致Sleep and diet rhythm disturbance，影响功能恢复

target_behavior.behavior: 自我贬低的自动化思维（如“我太笨了学not会”）
antecedent: 看到或回想物理课差成绩
收到作业/考试/老师反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: 将单次失败进行全局化归因，并把智力与自我价值刚性地绑定以解释not确定性与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 通过自责获得一种“确定的解释”与短期控制感，避免直面具体skill/方法的调整与not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: 加剧Anxiety与低自尊，削弱学习动机与坚持度，维持失败Anticipation与回避循环

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance（减少与同学互动/讨论学业）
antecedent: 课堂讨论或小组合作情境
The moment of preparing to talk to classmates or friends about academic distress and feelings
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心暴露自己not足会被评判/看轻，产生羞耻与Being rejected的恐惧
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评价的威胁与羞耻体验，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 减少获得学业与情感支持的机会，主观Loneliness感增加，维持负性信念与功能受损
